content.text: MatchMatch Dating App & Dating WebsiteIt's time to date differently.Matchgender gender seek selectBetween Ages:Between Ages:Minimum ageandMaximum agezipcode inputWe use this to provide and personalize your experience.fromYou know what you want.We’re here tohelp you find it.You’re looking for something real. An authentic connection that is built on deep conversations, quality time, and shared goals. You’re not afraid to commit, and you’re not afraid to be honest about what you need for the long-term. And above all, you know that your best self deserves to be with someone else’s best self.Welcome to Match, where you can be your most confident, authentic, open, and curious self with a community of daters like you. Our members are emotionally mature adults who want meaningful relationships. They value their time and energy. They’re ready to throw out the checklists and approach dating from a whole new perspective.From the initial spark to the first date and beyond, we’re with you every step of the way. Join Match today and start dating authentically.Features that encourage deep connections.From customizable search filters to IRL experiences, our dating site is focused on helping you date more meaningfully, while encouraging you to be your most confident, authentic self in a community of emotionally mature daters who truly get you.Find what you’re looking for.Find what you’re looking for.It’s time to date differently and be open and honest with what you’re looking for on the app. With the Dating Intention filter, select your dating goal to better align with other members on the app. Whether you’re looking for a serious relationship or still figuring things out, sharing your intent on your profile is the best way to help you find potential matches who meet your dating goals.HighlightsMeet our standout members.Highlights are curated daily, just for you. We choose the people we think you’ll be most compatible with along with a number of standout profiles. This feature shows you profiles of members who share multiple common interests such as age, job, location, education, and hobbies.Once you see someone you like, all you have to do is send a Super Like. Then, if they match with you, go ahead and say hello.Share values with someone who values you.Share values with someone who values you.When we know our values, we can easily share what we stand for and attract the people we want to date. Are weekly meet-ups with friends non-negotiable? Is building trust a bigger deal after a past relationship? Do you want a partner who prioritizes ambition as much as you do?We’ve made it easy to put your values into action with our Core Values feature. Choose what you value most from a list of options, and then add it to your profile. If another member shares one or more core values with you, we’ll display it and encourage you to start a conversation.After all, 93% of Match members say that shared core values are a crucial indicator of relationship success.72 HoursReady to shake up your weekend?Date smarter with 72 Hours: the fastest way to get to a first date. This three-day experience is free to join and only available within the app.Head to the Meet tab within the app and join the waitlist to be reminded when the next experience begins. Each weekend, members appear on your map based on age and distance preferences. All chats and connections disappear when the countdown clock strikes zero. So get out there and meet up this weekend.Download the app today so you don’t miss the next 72 Hours experience!Get theMatch app.Download the app for free to access unique features like 72 Hours and Core Values. As a member, you can message your matches for free, show off your personality with reflective topics, and add your interests to spark conversations.Ready for something real? Our free dating app is designed to make it easy for you to find it.Download the appMatch EventsYou’re invited to break the ice.Experience Match in your city!Mingle with other members and meet new friends. Our in-person events are designed to help you make meaningful connections with members in your area.Casual ways to meet people.We host a variety of events, like wine tastings, cooking classes, indoor golf, and more. These experiences are safe, fun, and low-pressure. Our events make it easy to cross the room and start a conversation.New events launch all the time.You’ll be informed of events in your area by a personal invitation via email, along with a notification on our website. All you need to do is RSVP, then show up as your best self at the event.Match CouplesSuccess storiesWe believe in love and work to create meaningful human connections for anyone, anywhere. Match is the place to find authentic, lasting connections, and we have the success stories to prove it.“We only lived one mile from each other, but without Match, this love story would not have be possible.”Tracy and Sadao“I can now say, without reservation, that I’ve found my adventure partner for life.”Heather and Jake“I literally gasped when I saw his picture, I can’t tell you why. Just the magic of love, I guess.”Charla and AlexSafetyTrust us to help you date safely.We continuously innovate to develop and integrate new safety technologies to improve our existing features and policies at Match. We’re committed to leading on these issues, making investments in safety tools, and working closely with other tech companies, lawmakers, and partners across the globe to make the internet safer for all. For more on our dating site’s policies, please visit our Safety and Privacy pages.TrustYour privacy is crucial.At Match, we believe every user should feel confident that their privacy is being protected online and in the app. It is at the core of the way we design and build the services that our users know and love, so that they can fully trust the experience and focus on building meaningful connections.Our ExpertiseThe authority in dating and relationships.Match pioneered online dating nearly 30 years ago and since then, we’ve remained the authority on all things dating. Our Singles in America study is the nation’s largest and most comprehensive annual scientific study on single adults, a segment that accounts for more than one-third of the U.S. adult population. Each year we uncover unprecedented shifts in dating, sex, and love.Singles know what they want.37% of singles are ready to find a long-term committed relationship. And 33% want to meet a partner in the next few months.You’ve got the keys.Singles agree that the three most important qualities in a healthy relationship are mutual respect, effective communication, and trust.Mind and body first.From therapy and exercise to burnout recovery, singles are getting better at self-care for the sake of themselves and their future relationships. A promising 37% of singles report “very good” mental health.Learn more*Based on results from Match’s 13th annual Singles in America study.Our MissionCreate meaningful human connections for anyone, anywhere.We’re here to do everything we can to help you find your person. Since 1995, we’ve created a space for intentional daters to connect through shared interests and explore the possibilities that come with real connection.Reassurance.Dating is an act of courage. Online dating can be daunting. Whatever stage of your dating journey you’re at, we want you to have the best online dating experience here, all while feeling secure and comfortable along the way.Anticipation.We know there are challenges that come with opening yourself up to someone new. Our job is to continue to innovate new features and content to help you navigate your dating journey.Thrill.Dating can have its bumpy moments, but the highs are like nothing else. The butterflies. The late-night conversations. The rush of that first kiss. Introducing them to your friends. Saying “I love you.” We’re here for all of it.
